from sympy import Matrix
from sympy.matrices.tests.test_commonmatrix import ShapingOnlyMatrix


def test_hstack_zero_rows_accumulates():
    # issue: all-0-row matrices must accumulate widths -> (0, 6)
    M1 = Matrix.zeros(0, 0)
    M2 = Matrix.zeros(0, 1)
    M3 = Matrix.zeros(0, 2)
    M4 = Matrix.zeros(0, 3)
    assert Matrix.hstack(M1, M2, M3, M4).shape == (0, 6)
    assert ShapingOnlyMatrix.hstack(M1, M2, M3, M4).shape == (0, 6)
    assert Matrix.hstack(M1, M2, M3, M4).cols == 6


def test_hstack_zero_cols_accumulates():
    M1 = Matrix.zeros(1, 0)
    M2 = Matrix.zeros(1, 1)
    M3 = Matrix.zeros(1, 2)
    M4 = Matrix.zeros(1, 3)
    assert Matrix.hstack(M1, M2, M3, M4).shape == (1, 6)
    assert ShapingOnlyMatrix.hstack(M1, M2, M3, M4).shape == (1, 6)


def test_vstack_zero_cols_accumulates():
    M1 = Matrix.zeros(0, 0)
    M2 = Matrix.zeros(1, 0)
    M3 = Matrix.zeros(2, 0)
    M4 = Matrix.zeros(3, 0)
    assert Matrix.vstack(M1, M2, M3, M4).shape == (6, 0)
    assert ShapingOnlyMatrix.vstack(M1, M2, M3, M4).shape == (6, 0)


def test_vstack_zero_rows_accumulates():
    M1 = Matrix.zeros(0, 1)
    M2 = Matrix.zeros(1, 1)
    M3 = Matrix.zeros(2, 1)
    M4 = Matrix.zeros(3, 1)
    assert Matrix.vstack(M1, M2, M3, M4).shape == (6, 1)
    assert ShapingOnlyMatrix.vstack(M1, M2, M3, M4).shape == (6, 1)


def test_zero_first_operand_hstack():
    # zeros(0,0) leading must not truncate
    assert Matrix.hstack(Matrix.zeros(0, 0), Matrix.zeros(0, 5)).shape == (0, 5)
    assert Matrix.hstack(Matrix.zeros(0, 5), Matrix.zeros(0, 0)).shape == (0, 5)

- col_join: + if other.rows == 0 and self.cols != other.cols: return other._new(0, self.cols, []).col_join(self)
- row_join: + if other.cols == 0 and self.rows != other.rows: return other._new(self.rows, 0, []).row_join(self)
Real code change, NOT comments/formatting/tests.

I RETRACT MY EARLIER NOTE'S FALSE CLAIM that the (1,6) case is handled by the "other.cols==0 row_join branch". That is wrong. Verified from source: hstack = reduce(kls.row_join, args) (common.py:366-382, docstring explicitly says row_join). Case 2 hstack(zeros(1,0),(1,1),(1,2),(1,3)): at every step self.rows==other.rows==1, so BOTH row_join guards are False (guard1 needs self.cols==0 AND self.rows!=other.rows; guard2 needs other.cols==0). It therefore falls through to _eval_row_join, which (read at common.py:149) does NOT validate columns and builds width self.cols+other.cols, indexing other[i, j-cols]. So case 2 concatenates widths -> (1,6).
=> Case 2 is ALREADY CORRECT AT BASE and is not fixed by patch-1; the issue itself reports 1.1 returning (1,6). The new row_join guard targets zeros(0,0)-vs-nonzero-col cases, not case 2.

- test_vstack passes but contains NO zero-size case at all -> exercises nothing issue-specific for vstack.

- Case 2 (1,6): correct by code reading, no public test asserts it.
